description: The parking area near the east wing has no functional lights after 7 PM making it unsafe for staff leaving late.
No authorised transport was arranged for female staff finishing shifts after 9 PM on weekdays.
A staff member reported repeated unwanted comments about appearance from a colleague during work hours.
Stairwell B on the second floor had flickering lights reported on three separate occasions.
Several employees were unaware of the internal grievance reporting process or the relevant contact person.
The access card system near the server room corridor was found to be non-functional for two consecutive days.
Female staff members reported having to walk to a distant bus stop alone after late shifts ended past 10 PM.
Basement parking had multiple broken lights and no CCTV coverage creating a feeling of insecurity.
A reported case of uncomfortable staring and following behaviour observed in the cafeteria during lunch breaks.
External visitors were seen accessing internal office areas without proper sign-in or escort procedures.
New joiners were not briefed about the Internal Complaints Committee during their induction programme.
The loading bay area used by warehouse staff has no lighting after dusk posing a safety risk.
The side gate used for late-shift exit had no security guard posted between 11 PM and 6 AM.
The IT lab door lock was reported to be faulty and could be pushed open without a valid access card.
A formal complaint was raised about persistent unwanted messages sent through the internal chat platform.
Warehouse staff reported they had never received training on how to raise a safety or harassment concern.
The corridor leading to the emergency exit on floor one has been without working lights for over a week.
No emergency contact number or security escort was available for staff working overnight in the north block.
Unauthorised personnel were observed attempting to enter the finance department on two separate occasions.
A staff member reported feeling pressured and intimidated during a one-on-one meeting with a senior colleague.
